title: Placeholder text needs an explicit AA color
rule: Never leave input placeholder text on the browser's default color: Chromium's grey (rgb 117,117,117) is about 3.7:1 on the dark background. Style `::placeholder` with a checked text token (`--fm-muted`) and `opacity: 1`, and add a Playwright check that computes the placeholder-to-background ratio from computed styles under both color schemes.
rationale: E5.10 (#73): the command palette and custom sample placeholders were 3.69:1 in the dark theme; the token-based contrast test could not see the browser default.
